FN-N369J8-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 55
Committee: Health Sponsor: Representative Juandalynn Givan
Analyst: Tiffany Weaver Date: 03/30/2023
House Bill 55 as introduced would require a one-time expenditure by the Alabama Department
of Public Health of an estimated $75,000 to establish a computer system to issue Certificates of
Nonviable Birth, pursuant to this bill.
Page 1

FN-N369J8-2
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 55
Committee: Health Sponsor: Representative Juandalynn Givan
Analyst: Tiffany Weaver Date: 04/05/2023
House Bill 55as reported by the Committee on Health would require a one-time expenditure by
the State Registrar of Vital Statistics under the Alabama Department of Public Health of an
estimated $75,000 to establish a computer system to issue Certificates of Nonviable Birth. This
expense could be offset, wholly or in part, by the collection of a $15 fee, provided for in this
bill, for the issuance each certificate.
